clearedSpotChecks.note: The verifier reran targeted.py for 4217 and 5042 on 2026-11-25 into cycles/018/stablecoin-l1.verify/targeted.json: 85,544 of 85,544 vectors matched on each network with no error. web3_clientVersion at https://rpc.mainnet.tempo.xyz returned tempo/v1.19.1-a9d6748/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu and arc_getVersion at https://rpc.mainnet.arc.io returned v0.8.6-rc1 commit 37812c61, so the runs hit the builds the item names. The edges cover mulmod(a, b, not(0)) and lt(mm, prod0) at src/libraries/FullMath.sol:24-25 and gt(remainder, prod0) at FullMath.sol:52, which the verifier read.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Lead L-582 for x86: the three x86 kernels of the evm2 jump destination scan at rev 35aa3280 copied unchanged and run natively on 442,577 bytecodes
clearedSpotChecks.note: The verifier fetched crates/evm2/src/bytecode/analysis/x86.rs and analysis.rs at 35aa32800b147b00e616d4e1869a3835aa86701f and diffed them with the harness copies in cycles/018/stablecoin-l1.work/l582/src. The only differences are pub visibility, the op import path, and the std feature switch around CPU detection; the kernel bodies and analyze_scalar are byte identical. main.rs calls a kernel then analyze_scalar from its returned pc, as analyze_legacy does, and its reference marks 0x5b outside PUSH1 to PUSH32 data. out.txt reports 0 mismatches per kernel and planted.txt shows a planted fault caught in every SIMD kernel. The tempo/v1.19.1 Cargo.lock pins evm2 at that rev. The aarch64 kernel remains unrun, as the unit's own lead says.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Whether any Arc validator release that can follow mainnet runs other arithmetic than the endpoints
clearedSpotChecks.note: The verifier fetched Cargo.lock at v0.8.0 and v0.8.6 of circlefin/arc-node: both pin revm 38.0.0, revm-interpreter 35.0.1 and ruint 1.20.0 from crates.io (registry source with checksum, not a git fork), and v0.8.7 and v0.9.0 return 404. The v0.8.6 CHANGELOG states that v0.8.6 and v0.8.5 carry no hardfork activation and that v0.8.5 and v0.8.4 fixed the execution cache and state root through arc-reth, which do not touch opcode arithmetic. The one unreadable link is commit 37812c61 behind rpc.mainnet.arc.io, already carried as a low lead.
